title: Module unit on an affine weakly contractible closed specialization neighbourhood
statement: Let i:Z to X be a closed immersion of schemes and V an affine object of the small pro-etale site of X [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Suppose every epimorphism of set sheaves is surjective on V-sections, and every point of V specializes to a point of V times_X Z. For any commutative ring sheaf A on X, and any adjunction between the constructed module inverse image i^-1_A and ring-unit scalar-restricted direct image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], its unit is bijective on V-sections at every A-module sheaf M.

source.place: Tag 09AC (lemma-compute-i-star), with Modules on Sites Tags 03D2 and 03D3 for the module-unit comparison.

proof.text: The abelian specialization theorem makes the actual abelian unit invertible on V-sections. Transport the adjunction through the strict AsSmall sheaf equivalences; uniqueness of left adjoints gives the same result for the canonical model-site abelian unit.

The actual model ring unit presents set inverse image. Apply the module/abelian comparison retaining its unit equation. Evaluating this equation shows the model module unit is an isomorphism on sections.

Compose the model module adjunction with the two module site equivalences. Their unit maps and the direct-image comparison are isomorphisms. The resulting actual-site unit is therefore bijective on V. Any other adjunction differs by the unit-compatible left-adjoint uniqueness isomorphism, preserving bijectivity.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtale_module_unit_bijective_of_specialization
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (V : X.ProEt) [IsAffine V.left]
    (hweak : ∀ (P Q : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (Type (u + 1))) (φ : P ⟶ Q),
      Epi φ → Function.Surjective (φ.hom.app (op V)))
    (hspec : ∀ x : V.left, ∃ z : ↥(pullback V.hom i),
      Specializes x ((pullback.fst V.hom i) z))
    (A : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (ai : proEtaleModuleInverseImage i A ⊣
      (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u + 1} (F := proEtaleBaseChange i)
      (J := ProEt.topology X) (K := ProEt.topology Z)
      (S := ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj A)) (R := ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology Z)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
        ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj A)))
      ⟨Functor.whiskerRight
        ((proEtaleSheafAdjunction i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).unit.app A).hom
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})⟩))
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj A)) :
    Function.Bijective ((ai.unit.app M).val.app (op V))
